Name: Translation Hub
Author: 4Moonnnn
Description:
[size=5][b]Translation Hub | 星露翻译管家[/b][/size]

[b]Use translations for any mod — without editing the mod, and without losing them when the mod updates.[/b]

[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Drop an extracted translation folder into [b]Mods/TranslationHub/Inbox[/b]. Next time the game starts it is matched to the right mod automatically.[/*]
[*]Translations are merged in memory. The original mod's files are never changed, so updating the original mod does not wipe your translation.[/*]
[*]Matching, from most to least certain: the translation's manifest UniqueID → the folder name (Nexus download numbers and words like "Chinese" / "Translation" are ignored) → the translation's keys compared with every installed mod. If none is certain, nothing is applied until you pick the mod in GMCM.[/*]
[*]Lines whose {{placeholders}} don't match the original are skipped, so a translation for an older version can't break dialogue.[/*]
[*]Two enabled translations for the same mod and language? Both are paused until you keep one, instead of silently mixing.[/*]
[*]One GMCM row per translation: a dropdown for the target mod and a checkbox to turn it on or off.[/*]
[*]Interface in 12 languages: English, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, Português, Русский, Türkçe, Magyar.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]. Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your Mods folder (you get TranslationHub and TranslationHubData).[/*]
[*]Download a translation, unzip it, and put the whole folder (the one containing i18n) into Mods/TranslationHub/Inbox.[/*]
[*]Start the game.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Console commands[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]th_status[/b] – show every translation's status and write status.json[/*]
[*][b]th_list[/b] – list installed mods and their UniqueIDs[/*]
[*][b]th_reload[/b] – rescan translations[/*]
[*][b]th_import[/b] – import a translation by path (advanced)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Supports standard SMAPI i18n translations (i18n/zh.json, i18n/zh/*.json …). Content Patcher / image replacement translations are not handled by this mod.[/*]
[*]After enabling, disabling or re-binding a translation, restart the game so cached text refreshes.[/*]
[*]Interface translations other than English and Chinese were not reviewed by native speakers — corrections are very welcome.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]星露翻译管家[/b][/size]

[b]给任何 Mod 装翻译，不用改原 Mod，原 Mod 更新也不会丢翻译。[/b]

[list]
[*]把解压后的翻译文件夹放进 [b]Mods/TranslationHub/Inbox[/b]，下次启动游戏自动认出是哪个 Mod 的翻译。[/*]
[*]翻译在内存中合并，不改原 Mod 的任何文件，原 Mod 更新后翻译照常生效。[/*]
[*]自动对应：先看翻译包 manifest 的 UniqueID，再看文件夹名（会忽略 N 网下载编号和"中文/汉化"等字样），最后比对翻译内容和已安装 Mod 的原文键。拿不准时不会应用，等你在 GMCM 里选。[/*]
[*]占位符 {{…}} 和原文对不上的句子会自动跳过，旧版本的翻译不会把对话弄坏。[/*]
[*]同一个 Mod、同一种语言有两份启用的翻译时会都暂停，等你只留一份，不会悄悄混用。[/*]
[*]GMCM 里每份翻译一行：下拉框选对应 Mod，右边勾选框开关翻译。[/*]
[*]界面支持 12 种语言。[/*]
[/list]
[b]安装[/b]：装好 SMAPI（GMCM 可选）→ 把本 Mod 解压到 Mods → 把翻译文件夹放进 Mods/TranslationHub/Inbox → 启动游戏。
